lab.name: S3 Research Lab — Zettelkasten + Compiler Optimization
lab.purpose: Durable compiler-research workspace and conversation handoff state

established_findings.post_m138: massive representation/lowering expansion; backend/codegen immaturity rather than language-fundamental cost
established_findings.p1: bounds/control lowering compressed branches and code size but did not reduce load/store count
established_findings.p2: same-basic-block scalar forwarding is safe/useful but removes only limited frame traffic
established_findings.p3: safe cross-block scalar residence removes targeted frame moves but large representative global counters remain effectively unchanged
established_findings.primary_remaining_bottleneck: frame canonicalization and cross-block store/reload traffic
established_findings.current_ra_architecture_fact: at the P3 anchor analyze_allocation already consumes whole-function CFG liveness, builds vreg interference, and performs deterministic greedy coloring; RA OFF vs RA ON must therefore be treated as a causal experimental control rather than assuming block-local RA

research_direction.name: global-value-residency-and-memory-materialization
research_direction.central_question: Where is location flexibility first lost and why does a logical value become memory-identified?
research_direction.default_hypothesis: logical values should remain location-flexible until memory is semantically or resource-wise required
candidate_models: residence lattice / reduced product abstract domain

hard_rules.production_changes_from_lab: port proven ideas to a fresh branch from current main
hard_rules.full_suite_policy: production final candidate only; not routine research iteration
